fieldValues.title: Both groups paused over the weekend: two unacknowledged reports stop all group building until the owner returns
fieldValues.summary: Each group pauses after 2 unacknowledged cycle reports (charter standing order). The reports of Friday 10-30 and Saturday 10-31 went unacknowledged, so from Saturday's cycle close both groups were paused and every hourly builder run exited at the pause check (for example the third-party-ready builder at 11:21 on 2026-11-02: 'paused: 2 reports unacknowledged', budget room 6). The owner's session at 11:40 on 2026-11-02 received seven reports and the pause cleared. About two days of build time were lost while 7 buildable ready issues waited.
evidence: rfc-drafter run session_01LP2XeEhUBj4HebxAr6CK2e (2026-11-03): wg:third-party-ready paused again ('paused: 2 reports unacknowledged', cycle 2026-11-03T11:30Z, room 6); both queued RFC requests srs#931 and srs#928 sit in that lane, so no RFC was drafted

local Claude Code session for the owner, 2026-11-03 ~18:50 UTC: clerk claim srs-web#698 (essay home, unit semanticops.com#54) refused: wg:agent-editor paused, 2 reports unacknowledged (cycles 11-02 and 11-03); the owner was present in the conversation and had just approved the plan, so the pause stopped work the owner was directing
fieldValues.body: The pause is a deliberate safety stop: the owner must be seeing the reports. But it cannot tell 'the owner is away for the weekend' from 'the owner is ignoring the group', and it stops on calendar time, not on what was built. Remedies to weigh: count unacknowledged reports only on working days, let a report with no merges and no decisions count as acknowledged, or acknowledge from the phone in one tap.
